findings.summary: Migration implementation extraction is duplicated and not used by runtime specs
findings.details: S05-T01 requires S00, S01, and S02 migration implementations to be extracted into task-owned implementation modules. The new S00/S01 modules contain executable definitions, but the legacy packages/convex/confect/internal/migrations.ts file still contains the same executable bodies and both migrations.spec.ts and migrations.impl.ts continue importing those legacy exports. As a result the focused runtime tests can pass while the new implementation modules are unused by the Confect runtime boundary, leaving duplicate sources of truth instead of the requested extraction.
